newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK SAYS WINS FIM 35 MLN ORDER.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK SAYS WINS FIM 35 MLN ORDER.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and building materials group Oy Partek Ab said in a statement on Friday it won an order for nine straddle carriers worth about 35 million markka.

"Steveco Oy ... and Partek's subsidiary Sisu Terminal Systems Oy ... have signed an agreement for the delivery of nine straddle carriers for the Hietanen harbour of the Port of Kotka. The deal is worth approximately 35 million markka. The carriers will be delivered between July 1997 and January 1998," Partek said.
Container traffic at the Hietanen harbour had doubled during the past five years and was expected to grow by approximately 10 percent per year in the next few years, it said.
